title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipeline
description: RAG composes retrieval with generation: the retriever finds relevant documents and the generator grounds its answer in them. The composition beats either part alone on knowledge-heavy tasks. The interface between them — what the retriever returns and how the generator cites — determines the quality.

demo.code:
docs = ["doc1: Paris is the capital", "doc2: of France."]
query = "capital of France?"
ctx = " ".join(docs)
print("retrieved:", ctx)
print("answer: Paris (cited from doc1)")

title: Multi-Agent Debate
description: Several agents argue different positions and a judge picks the winner, composing diverse reasoning into a better answer. Debate surfaces flaws that single-agent reasoning misses. The composition works because disagreement is information.

demo.code:
positions = {"A": "yes because X", "B": "no because Y"}
judge = "B wins: Y refutes X"
print("positions:", positions)
print("judge:", judge)

title: Tool-Using Agent Loop
description: The classic ReAct loop composes reasoning with tool calls: think, act, observe, repeat. Each iteration's observation feeds the next thought. The composition turns a language model into an agent that accomplishes multi-step tasks.

demo.code:
for i in range(3):
    print("step %d: thought -> action(calc) -> observation" % i)
print("done: answer assembled from 3 tool results")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'ReAct loop', 'components': 'LLM + tools', 'composition': 'Think-act-observe', 'emergent': 'Multi-step task completion', 'benefit': 'Agents from models', 'complexity': 'Medium'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'components', 'composition', 'emergent', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")

title: Mixture of Experts Routing
description: MoE composes many expert networks with a router that sends each token to the best experts. Total parameters grow huge while compute per token stays small. The composition scales capacity without scaling cost.

demo.code:
experts, active = 64, 2
print("experts:", experts, "active per token:", active)
print("compute fraction: %.1f%%" % (100 * active / experts))
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'MoE', 'components': 'Experts + router', 'composition': 'Route then compute', 'emergent': 'Huge capacity, flat cost', 'benefit': 'Scales to trillions of params', 'complexity': 'High'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'components', 'composition', 'emergent', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")

title: Planner-Executor Split
description: A planner decomposes the task and an executor carries out the steps, composing high-level reasoning with grounded action. The planner never touches tools; the executor never plans. Separation of concerns makes both parts more reliable.

demo.code:
plan = ["search", "read", "summarize"]
for i, s in enumerate(plan, 1): print("step %d: %s -> done" % (i, s))
print("planner verified each step before the next")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'Planner-executor', 'components': 'Planner + executor', 'composition': 'Plan then execute', 'emergent': 'Reliable long tasks', 'benefit': 'Separation of concerns', 'complexity': 'Medium'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'components', 'composition', 'emergent', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")

title: Self-Consistency Voting
description: The model samples many reasoning paths and takes the majority answer, composing diverse attempts into a robust verdict. Wrong paths scatter; right paths converge. The composition trades compute for reliability.

demo.code:
answers = ["42", "42", "17", "42", "42"]
from collections import Counter
winner = Counter(answers).most_common(1)[0]
print("samples:", answers)
print("winner:", winner[0], "with", winner[1], "votes")

title: Verification-Computation Split
description: One model generates and another verifies, composing creativity with criticism. The verifier need not solve the task, only check it, which is often easier. The composition catches errors the generator cannot see.

demo.code:
proposal = "proof of X"
checks = ["step1 ok", "step2 FAILS", "step3 ok"]
print("proposal:", proposal)
print("verifier:", checks)
print("result: revise step2, resubmit")

title: Memory-Augmented Composition
description: An agent composed with long-term memory retrieves past experiences relevant to the current task. Memory turns one-shot attempts into cumulative learning. The composition improves with use instead of staying static.

demo.code:
memory = {"deploy bug": "check env vars first"}
task = "deploy bug again"
print("recall:", memory["deploy bug"])
print("agent applies past lesson immediately")

title: Chained Summarization Pipeline
description: Long documents are summarized in chunks, then chunk summaries are summarized, composing local understanding into global. The map-reduce pattern handles arbitrary lengths. Quality depends on the chunk boundaries and the reduce prompt.

demo.code:
chunks = ["part1", "part2", "part3"]
summaries = ["s1", "s2", "s3"]
print("map:", list(zip(chunks, summaries)))
print("reduce: final summary from s1+s2+s3")

title: Critic-Actor Refinement Loop
description: An actor produces and a critic scores, iterating until the critic is satisfied, composing generation with judgment. Each round improves on the last. The loop converges because the critic's feedback is specific.

demo.code:
score = 60
round = 0
while score < 90:
    round += 1; score += 15
    print("round %d score %d" % (round, score))
print("converged at round", round)

title: Ensemble of Specialists
description: Different models handle different subtasks and a router assembles the answers, composing specialist excellence. No single model must do everything. The ensemble beats any generalist on the covered tasks.

title: Constitutional Feedback Loop
description: The model critiques its own output against a constitution and revises, composing generation with self-governance. The loop internalizes the rules. Behavior aligns without human labels per example.

demo.code:
draft = "rough answer"
critique = "violates rule 3: be specific"
print("draft:", draft)
print("critique:", critique)
print("revised: specific answer honoring rule 3")

title: Retriever-Reader-Reranker Stack

print("reader: answer from top 10 (200ms)")

title: Composition Safety Analysis
description: Composed systems need safety analysis of the composition, not just the parts: safe parts can compose into unsafe wholes. The analysis checks emergent behaviors explicitly. Evaluation must cover the system, not the components.

demo.code:
parts_safe = True
composed = "parts safe, composition leaks data via side channel"
print("parts safe:", parts_safe)
print("finding:", composed)
print("evaluate the WHOLE system")

title: Prompt Chaining Patterns
description: Complex tasks split into prompt chains where each prompt's output feeds the next, composing simple steps into sophisticated behavior. Chains are debuggable step by step. The pattern library documents proven chains.

demo.code:
chain = ["extract", "classify", "summarize"]
data = "raw text"
for step in chain:
    data = step + "(" + data + ")"
    print(step, "->", data)

title: Evaluation Harness for Compositions
description: Composed systems are evaluated end-to-end with task success as the metric, plus per-stage diagnostics. The harness attributes failures to stages. Composition quality is measured, not assumed.

demo.code:
stages = {"retriever": 95, "reader": 88}
bottleneck = min(stages, key=stages.get)
print("stage scores:", stages)
print("bottleneck:", bottleneck, "-> fix this first")
